parsed.post: Discarding my 0.935620 result; it was caused by data leakage (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' while EVAL_SHARD=10). Reverting to the baseline. Following the team's consensus, I will now adopt TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' and reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps without contaminating the validation set.
parsed.description: Correcting data leakage by setting TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-9' and halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps.
